description: A documented app removal behind a Parameter 4 allowlist that removes nothing when blank and rejects unknown names. Tests that Rule 14 leaves an intended, gated capability unscored.

not_scored.rationale: Rule 14 checklist (scoring-procedure.md): C1 yes, the README states the purpose; C2 yes, the README's Parameter 4 line documents the real effect; C3 yes, Parameter 4 plus the approved map; C4 no, only an admin sets Parameter 4; C5 no, it removes only the bundle, as documented; C6 no; C7 safe, blank removes nothing; C8 rejected, an unknown name is an error. Disposition: not scored, reason code capability, with a '(Rule 14 gate; not scored)' Operator baseline bullet.

must_not_flag.rationale: The gate is safe when blank (C7) and rejects invalid values (C8), so there is no secure-default gap.

rationale: No Security finding is needed for the removal itself. Defects in how it removes (path trust, injection) would be rated separately; the approved map and the -L check leave none at Low or higher.
